summary: The prepared source already contains the issue-specific candidate fix from upstream PR #33614 (commit f60bc73c5836d45457575c17f4722c6bd60f06b0): DFlash now broadcasts greedy target predictions and other acceptance decisions from TP rank 0 before deriving committed tokens and state. The reported image commit 5f55db35e926d50676f75b812640ea2410b0fe0e predates that fix. Added regression coverage for greedy, stochastic, and selector acceptance paths. Exact Qwen3.8-27B target-vs-DFlash output equivalence remains unverified because the assigned environment has one AMD gfx950 GPU and lacks both reported model checkpoints, versus the report's four NVIDIA GPUs and TP=4.

tests.what_was_measured: All 13 DFlash logits/unit regressions passed, including the three new acceptance-path TP synchronization boundary cases. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-21cdfd37193e/test-dflash-logits.log

tests.command: Import dflash_worker_v2 from exact reported commit 5f55db35 and assert DFlashWorkerV2._accept_block exists
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before evidence: the reported image source has no centralized synchronized acceptance boundary. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-21cdfd37193e/pre-fix-regression.log
A real tensor addition executed on cuda:0, identified by PyTorch as AMD Instinct MI350X with ROCm 7.2 and capability (9, 5). Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-21cdfd37193e/gpu-evidence.log

gpu_execution.evidence: A real PyTorch tensor operation ran on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950. This was only an environment/device check; it did not execute DFlash or either Qwen3.8-27B checkpoint.

remaining_limitations: The original reproduction requires four NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPUs with tensor parallelism 4; only one AMD MI350X/gfx950 was assigned.
The Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B target and incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 weights were not available locally.
Therefore the exact token-30 divergence, thinking/no-thinking control, full model architecture, CUDA/NCCL behavior, and multi-rank runtime behavior were not reproduced.
The evidence verifies the source-level correction and its decision-boundary regression, not semantic equivalence of the full reported model run.
